Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: ORCHESTRATOR (2026-09-26): press-ahead dispatch off origin/ai-c11-cc/phase-machine @ f7faccd (PR #15 at review). Worktree sessions, branch ai-c11-cc/sessions, delegator agent:delegator-pq5, inline-full. Sibling PQ-6 (transport) runs in parallel on the same parent; shared-file split is in the boot prompt.
READY PQ-5 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/sessions HEAD f7faccdf20e79c783e3945e4598eba4cc29e4962 BASE f7faccdf20e79c783e3945e4598eba4cc29e4962 MODE active

BLOCKED PQ-5: commit signing fails. 1Password: 'Could not connect to socket' (sandboxed), then 'failed to fill whole buffer' (retry), then the approved ssh-keygen fallback: 'Couldn't sign message (signer): communication with agent failed?' although ssh-add -l lists the signing key. Implementation is done and staged (session map + seam); just test-room green in 6.2 s warm. Waiting on the client to unlock/approve 1Password signing; no signing bypass used.

ORCHESTRATOR: this is recoverable, not the client's. Your errors ('Could not connect to socket (sandboxed)', 'communication with agent failed') mean the commit ran inside the Bash sandbox, where the 1Password agent socket is denied. The verifier and phase-machine tabs signed commits at 04:24 and 04:27 tonight with the same key. Run git commit with the sandbox bypass (dangerouslyDisableSandbox on that one Bash call; approve the prompt if it appears), verify with git log --show-signature -1, then lattice status PQ-5 in_progress and continue the arc. Never --no-gpg-sign. Your lib.rs one-liner (pub mod sessions;) is accepted; note it under deviations. phase.rs untouched is correct.

RE ORCHESTRATOR NOTE: retried with the sandbox bypass as asked. Result: '1Password: failed to fill whole buffer', HEAD still f7faccd. The earlier bypassed attempts failed the same way, and the approved ssh-keygen fallback (SSH_AUTH_SOCK = 1Password agent.sock, key ZmDAi3... listed by ssh-add -l) failed with 'communication with agent failed?'. Only the first attempt was sandboxed. The agent is reachable but refuses to sign: 1Password needs unlocking or its approval prompt answering, which only the client can do. Staying in needs_human with the flag up; the first commit is staged and ready to retry.
UNBLOCKED PQ-5: signing works again (1Password approved on retry). Four signed commits 912f488..dd36b44 on ai-c11-cc/sessions. Moving to code review.

ORCHESTRATOR (09:09): 1Password signing works again (probe signed in 1 s). Retry your staged commit now with the sandbox bypass on that one Bash call, verify with git log --show-signature -1, move the ticket back to in_progress, and continue the arc: push, PR against ai-c11-cc/phase-machine (stacked on #15), review status, DONE. Never bypass signing.

ORCHESTRATOR: PQ-6 (transport) is at review with PR #17 stacked on #15. Do NOT wire its ws::SessionTokens seam on your branch; a follow-up ticket does the wiring after both PRs merge. Finish your own arc: push (the prompt in your tab is the client's), PR against ai-c11-cc/phase-machine stacked on #15, review status, DONE.

DONE PQ-5 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/18 HEAD dd36b44c1f352e7beb51f4d103d05d3eaaa5e2cb BASE f7faccdf20e79c783e3945e4598eba4cc29e4962 test-warm 5.0s deviations: 1) lib.rs gets one line, 'pub mod sessions;', although it is not in the cleared list; a new module needs it. 2) The join route is POST /join {code}, not /rooms/{code}/join, because axum cannot mount {code} beside {id} at the same segment. 3) Join, answer and leave write counts via Room::set_live_counts under the held rooms lock; AppState::set_live_counts would re-lock. README and the rooms.rs doc updated. 4) view.rs gains buzzer_for() beside the one 'yours' field; view::buzzer is unchanged. 5) Trait methods join/upsert/answer_of/leave/counts/session_count are added to rooms::Sessions under '// T-04b', with defaults, so NoSessions and the test doubles compile unchanged. 6) The idle-answer 409 'reason' is inline plain words, not from copy.rs (off-limits); clients render from phase/saved. 7) The ticket header says it touches phase.rs (F-10); the boot prompt forbids that, and nothing needed it. notes: 'Not yet open' has no reachable state (rooms are born in idle; the idle buzzer says You're in) and ships unreached, which is a contract question for SPEC §4.1. Ghost sessions keep their slot, answer and place in present until AppState::leave, which PQ-6 must call only when a socket is gone for good, never on a mere drop (AC-37). PQ-6's seams: AppState::leave(room, token) and AppState::buzzer_for(room, token). The shared-file overlap with PQ-6 is routes.rs (my block is delimited '// T-04b routes') and rooms.rs (additive). ac52_in_process_reconciliation supplements AC-52 and does not discharge it. Commit signing needed a retry once 1Password was approved; all four commits verified Good signature. CI queued at PR open.
NOTE: the parallel attach + status write in the PR step raced and the status reverted to in_progress. Re-set to review serially and verified.

ORCHESTRATOR: DONE verified (PR #18 @ dd36b44 == remote, stacked on #15, MERGEABLE, review PASS-WITH-NITS on the head; CI running, re-checked before merge). Deviations accepted; the wiring of PQ-6's seam is PQ-32's. Your tab closes now; thank you.
